name: jev-checkpoints
description: Jev (TypeSafe System One) as a cheap timing judge for when the Opus advisor is worth consulting (ADR-2134/ADR-2135): done-claim, repeated-failure and plan checkpoints inject one advisory line; subagent model routing is shadow-only by default. Fail-open, email-fenced, never sends tool-result contents.

api.title: System One endpoint
api.description: Full URL of the System One decision endpoint. Empty means TypeSafe's cloud (https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone). A loopback or LAN host (an ADR-2094 sovereign façade) is treated as local: it may be asked from an email-tainted session and needs no key.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id sent with every request.

timeoutMs.title: Request deadline (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Longest wait for one Jev answer; past it the checkpoint does nothing (fail-open). Clamped to 250–30000.

doneCheck.title: Done checkpoint
doneCheck.description: After a turn whose final text claims completion, ask whether it did so without a verifying run; above the threshold, advise on the next prompt.

doneThreshold.title: Done threshold
doneThreshold.description: Score (0–1) at or above which the done checkpoint injects.

repeatCheck.title: Repeat checkpoint
repeatCheck.description: Local only, never calls Jev: fingerprint failing Bash and test-runner results and advise once when the same failure recurs.

repeatCount.title: Repeat count
repeatCount.description: Occurrences of one failure fingerprint in a session before the repeat checkpoint injects (an integer, at least 2).

planCheck.title: Plan checkpoint
planCheck.description: On each prompt, ask whether it needs a multi-file plan or touches an auth, schema, API or data contract; above the threshold, advise consulting the advisor first.

planThreshold.title: Plan threshold
planThreshold.description: Score (0–1) at or above which the plan checkpoint injects.

minChars.title: Minimum prompt length
minChars.description: Prompts shorter than this (and slash commands) are never sent to the plan checkpoint.

spawnMode.title: Spawn checkpoint
spawnMode.description: off: never asked. shadow: Jev picks a subagent tier and the pick is only logged. enforce: the pick replaces the model when the caller named none, confidence clears the bar, it is no larger than the main model and the agent's definition pins no model.

spawnMinConfidence.title: Spawn minimum confidence
spawnMinConfidence.description: Jev confidence (0–1) the enforce mode needs before it rewrites a subagent's model.

shadowLog.title: Spawn shadow log
shadowLog.description: JSONL file each spawn decision is appended to (ADR-2110 teacher labels). Empty turns the log off. A leading ~/ is the home directory.

usdPerMTokIn.title: Price (USD per million input tokens)
usdPerMTokIn.description: What the endpoint bills per million input tokens; output is free. 0 for a self-hosted façade.
